{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Water Ox''' (癸丑, ''mizunoto ushi''; onyomi ''kichū'') is the 50th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 50th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子|1=Yang Water Rat}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Wood Tiger|ja|甲寅|1=Yang Wood Tiger}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''癸'' is Yin Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''丑'' (Ox) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Water Ox (癸丑)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): guǐchǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gwai2 cau2
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Mizunoto-ushi
***Kunyomi 2: Kisui-no-ushi
***Onyomi 1: kichi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyechuk (계축)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Quý Sửu

A {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 53 when divided by 60 is a year of Yin Water Ox (癸丑).

==Months of Yin Water Ox==
The twelfth month (December) of Gregorian calendar years ending in 2 or 7 (Heavenly Stems 壬 or 丁) corresponds to Kinoe-Ushi months. However, this applies to the {{ill|Lunar calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunar calendar}} or {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar terms|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Shōkan|1=Xiaohan}} to the day before {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun|1=Lichun}}) in traditional contexts.

==Days of Yin Water Ox==
=== Auspicious Dates ===
Days of Kinoe-Ushi are noted as intercalary days during the {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}} period.
